title_en: Graduation Application for Undergraduates Expecting to Graduate in February 2027
summary: Undergraduate students in the Aerospace Engineering major of the School of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering and in the Department of Aerospace Engineering who wish to graduate in February 2027 must submit their graduation application documents by Wednesday, 16 September 2026. Documents go to the department office (Building 301, Room 217) or by email to the staff member in charge. After submitting the documents, students must also complete the online graduation application by 23 September.
applies_to: Undergraduate students in the Aerospace Engineering major (우주항공공학전공) of the School of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering (기계항공공학부) and in the Department of Aerospace Engineering (항공우주공학과) who wish to graduate in February 2027. This includes students who deferred graduation last semester, who must apply again. The paper application and the online application are both mandatory for anyone who wishes to graduate.

conditions: Students who deferred graduation last semester must apply again and must also submit their thesis again.
The online graduation application is mandatory after submitting the documents; students who cannot apply in the system must contact the department administrative office.
The list of graduation candidates is confirmed only for students who submitted the graduation application documents.
Students expecting to graduate must be registered for the regular semester; unregistered students are removed from the list of graduation candidates.
Students admitted in 2016 or later must submit the Life Respect (Suicide Prevention) training certificate; without it they cannot graduate.
Students who have not completed the Life Respect training must complete it later and then submit the certificate.
The multi-major confirmation form is required only for students with a multiple major.
One copy of the graduation thesis must be submitted to the department administrative office.
Students who wish to cancel and defer graduation this semester for personal reasons must submit the signed Graduation Application Cancellation form.
Students who do not meet the graduation requirements must also submit the cancellation form.

Students must have taken at least three courses taught in a foreign language, including at least one major course; for students admitted in 2012 or later, College English 1, College English 2 and Advanced English do not count.
For freshmen admitted in 2024 or later, the foreign-language course requirement is relaxed from mandatory to recommended.
Course classifications (major required, major elective, general elective) must be changed as needed; this is possible only after completing the Fall 2026 courses.
steps: Read this notice and the attachments carefully (the attachments were not read for this translation).

Check the Korean and English name to be printed on the diploma in mySNU: 학생서비스 (Student Services) > 나의정보 (My Information) > 종합정보 (General Information) > 개인정보수정 (Edit Personal Information); if a change is needed, apply via mySNU: 학생서비스 > 학적변동 (Academic Status Change) > 신청 (Apply) > 학적부기재사항정정 (Correction of Academic Record Entries).
Complete the Graduation Application Form (Attachment 1), sign it yourself, and leave the department staff confirmation and the advisor/department chair signature fields blank.

Complete the Course Completion Check Card for your admission year (Attachment 6), including courses planned for Fall 2026 and marking retaken courses separately; read the notes at the bottom of the card and the graduation requirements for your admission year on the Department of Aerospace Engineering website.

If admitted in 2016 or later, prepare your Life Respect (Suicide Prevention) training certificate; if you have not completed the training, complete it when sessions are announced and submit the certificate afterwards.
Multiple-major students only: fill in the blue-text parts of Attachment 2 (Multiple Major Preliminary Graduation Review Confirmation) and have it confirmed by your multiple-major department.
Submit all documents by Wednesday, 16 September 2026 to the department office (Building 301, Room 217) or by email to the staff member in charge (contact in the original notice).
Complete the online graduation application by 23 September 2026; if the system does not allow it, contact the department administrative office.
Submit one copy of your graduation thesis to the department administrative office by the deadline that will be announced to you individually.
After completing your Fall 2026 courses, change course classifications as needed, following Attachment 5 (course classification change and retake correction guide).
If you decide to cancel and defer graduation, or do not meet the graduation requirements, complete and sign the Graduation Application Cancellation form (Attachment 3) and submit it.
translation:
[Undergraduate] Graduation Application for Students Expecting to Graduate in February 2027

This is the graduation application notice for students expecting to graduate in February 2027.

Students in the Aerospace Engineering major (우주항공공학전공) of the School of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering and in the Department of Aerospace Engineering (항공우주공학과) who wish to graduate in February 2027 should read the information below and the attachments carefully, and submit their graduation application documents to the department office (Building 301, Room 217) or by email to the staff member in charge by Wednesday, 16 September 2026. (The email address is in the original notice.)

[Documents to submit when applying for graduation] – by Wednesday, 16 September
* Students who deferred graduation last semester must also apply again.
* After submitting the documents, the online graduation application is mandatory (by 23 September). Students who cannot apply in the system should contact the department (school) administrative office.

[Documents to submit]
1. Graduation Application Form (졸업신청서)
 - Sign the form yourself and submit it.
 - Leave the department staff confirmation field and the advisor/department chair signature fields blank.

2. Course Completion Check Card for your admission year (이수과목 확인카드) (attached)
 - Check the card that corresponds to your student ID year.
 - When filling it in, include the courses you plan to take in Fall 2026 (mark retaken courses separately).
 - You must read the notes at the bottom of the card and the graduation requirements by admission year (학번별 졸업이수규정 - 학부 - Seoul National University Department of Aerospace Engineering).

3. Life Respect / Suicide Prevention training certificate (applies from students admitted in 2016)
 - For students admitted in 2016 or later, Life Respect (Suicide Prevention) training is mandatory, so the certificate must be submitted. Students who do not submit it cannot graduate.
 - Students who have not completed it must complete the training later and then submit the certificate. (The training schedule will be announced on the Department of Aerospace Engineering website once the official notice arrives.)

4. Multiple Major Confirmation Form (only for relevant students)
 - Fill in the blue-text parts of Attachment 2, 'Multiple Major Preliminary Graduation Review Confirmation' (다전공 예비졸업사정 확인서), to match your situation, have it confirmed by your multiple-major department, and submit it.
 (Marking multiple-major courses separately on your cumulative transcript allows accurate processing when requested.)

[Additional documents]
5. Graduation thesis – the deadline will be announced individually to graduation applicants.
 - One copy must be submitted to the department administrative office.

[Submitting a Graduation Cancellation Request]
 - If you wish to cancel this semester's graduation application and defer graduation for personal reasons, fill in the attached form, sign it and submit it.
 - If you do not meet the graduation requirements, you must also submit the cancellation request.

[Important notes]
* The list of graduation candidates is confirmed only for students who have submitted the graduation application documents (the online application is mandatory after submitting the documents).
* Students expecting to graduate must be registered for the regular semester. Students who are not registered will be removed from the list of graduation candidates.
* Students who applied for graduation in a previous semester and then cancelled (deferred) must apply again and must also submit their thesis again.
* Check the requirement to take at least three courses taught in a foreign language, including at least one major course – you must read the attachment. (For students admitted in 2012 or later, College English 1, College English 2 and Advanced English are excluded.)
 (For freshmen admitted in 2024 or later, the foreign-language course standard has been relaxed from 'mandatory' to 'recommended'.)
* Check your Korean/English name to be printed on the diploma (degree certificate).
 - How to check: mySNU – 학생서비스 (Student Services) – 나의정보 (My Information) – 종합정보 (General Information) – 개인정보수정 (Edit Personal Information)
 - If a change is needed: mySNU – 학생서비스 (Student Services) – 학적변동 (Academic Status Change) – 신청 (Apply) – 학적부기재사항정정 (Correction of Academic Record Entries)
* You must change the grade course classification (major required 전필, major elective 전선, general elective 일선) as needed – refer to (Attachment 5) the guide to changing course classification and correcting retake classification.
 (Changes are possible after completing the courses taken in Fall 2026.)

[Inquiries and submission] Telephone (in the original notice) / Building 301, Room 117
(Note: the notice gives Room 217 earlier and Room 117 here; please confirm with the department office.)
